value.description: The current value of the textarea.

count.description: The number of characters in the value.

countText.description: The word count text, e.g. `42 / 250 characters`. `null` without `maxLength` or when the text is turned off.

id.description: The unique identifier of the textarea.

ids.description: The ids of the parts other elements reference: `textarea` (the `for` of its label) and `wordCount`.

name.description: The name of the textarea, as it is submitted with the form. Taken from the closest field.

disabled.description: Whether the textarea is disabled. Taken from the closest field.

readOnly.description: Whether the textarea is read-only. Taken from the closest field.

required.description: Whether the textarea is required. Taken from the closest field.

invalid.description: Whether the textarea is invalid. Taken from the closest field.

defaultValue.description: The initial value of the textarea.

maxLength.description: The most characters allowed. It also drives the word count, e.g. `42 / 250 characters`.

submitOn.description: Submits the closest `<form>` on a keypress instead of inserting a newline. `'enter'` submits on Enter, Shift+Enter still inserts a newline. `'mod+enter'` submits on Cmd or Ctrl+Enter, Enter always inserts a newline. By default Enter is never intercepted.

translations.description: The localized texts of the textarea.

announce.description: Whether the word count is announced to assistive tech. Set to `false` to stay silent.

announceDebounce.description: Milliseconds to debounce word count announcements by, so rapid typing doesn't spam assistive tech on every keystroke. Set to 0 to announce every change immediately.

transform.description: Runs on every native `input` event, before the value is committed. Return the value to write back to the textarea, e.g. trimmed. The cursor position is kept. It cannot be set from a Fluid template, only by constructing `Textarea` in your own entry file.
